**B. 10%.** The World Bank estimated about 8.4% of the world population (roughly 648 million people) lived on less than $1.90 a day in 2019, and 10% is the closest option. The team note's figure of 1.9 billion looks wrong. It would imply about 25%, and I think it confuses the $1.90 threshold with a head count.

CONFIDENCE: 88
